gen-tourney-bitter: Tourney stretches its bulky, oversized small letters across wide tracking, every stroke cut to a single width, loud and athletic. Bitter, a dependable slab-serif, grounds it with a very large lowercase eye.
gen-gf-goldman-poppins: Goldman sets its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses. Poppins brings tall, sturdy lowercase and curves free of thick-thin flicker, so nothing competes with the wide-set heading above.
gen-tourney-rubik: Bold Tourney cuts every stroke to a single width and stretches its words with wide tracking. Rubik keeps paragraphs soft and clear, its open rounds staying legible when small.
gen-gf-warnes-mulish: Spacious ink strokes that taper off before touching: that is Warnes, stretched wide. Mulish sits underneath with no thick-thin modulation and a large x-height, so the sans keeps up without competing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Neon-tube roundness, that's Comfortaa, with a wide-open ring for a c and spacing stretched like an uncoiled spring. Comfortaa earns its keep big and short, above Padyakke Expanded One.
gen-dafont-franchise-fs-literata: Tall, tightly packed Franchise looks cut from a bent steel rod. Literata settles in with sturdy thin lines and wide-mouthed curves, so a stretch of text sounds bookish and unhurried.
gen-eater-gf-fauna-one: Eater sprawls with wide letter gaps and thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, dark and aggressive. Fauna One then settles into a tall middle band with shallow ascenders, reading dignified and literary.
gen-eater-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text gives each curved letter a big visible entrance, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Beneath dark, aggressive Eater, it reads dignified, literary and smooth.
gen-eater-gf-piazzolla: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide letter gaps and thin strokes that never drop to hairlines. Piazzolla, refined, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, steadies the whole layout.
gen-gf-metamorphous-poppins: Poppins reads tall and sturdy, its curves loose and its strokes free of thick-thin flicker. Metamorphous, with generous sidebearings and soft fat-to-slim strokes, adds the commanding voice on top.
